verdict.rationale: Linear provides evidence of AI-driven automation for routing/labeling/prioritizing incoming feedback into issues (docs-62) and agents that can investigate/attempt fixes on new issues before reaching engineers (docs-45), which supports triage automation. However, there's no clear evidence of a dedicated, robust 'auto-triage and prioritize all incoming bugs' pipeline with configurable rules—most agent evidence focuses on coding/dev workflows (writing code, reviews, loops) rather than systematic bug/task prioritization at scale.
